Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing the source and edited images, what does the visual evidence establish about the requested move of the source mug to the right of the headphones: complete fulfillment, partial progress, no progress, or unresolved?
node.criteria: Pass only when visual evidence reliably establishes that the source mug itself is now positioned to the right of the same headphones. A mug on the right alone, or a source-location remnant together with a different or unidentifiable mug on the right, does not establish fulfillment. Fail only when evidence reliably establishes that no relevant progress toward the requested move occurred. Treat credible visual evidence of an attempted or incomplete move as partial progress even if the source mug's identity or final position is uncertain. For example, a remnant at the source mug's former location together with changed or additional mugs can support attempted/incomplete progress without proving that a right-side mug is the source mug. A right-side mug alone, without other evidence of movement, is insufficient to establish progress. Use unknown when the evidence supports neither relevant progress nor no progress, or cannot determine whether the requested condition is fulfilled; do not turn uncertainty into proof of no progress or complete fulfillment.
node.binding: Cross-image binding: the source blue mug and the same headphones in the source and edited images. Compare the source mug with visible edited mugs and assess their positions relative to the headphones. Consider appearance, scale, and other visual correspondence when determining whether a right-side mug is the source mug; inspect the source mug's former location for evidence of a remnant or movement. Allow for changes in scale, lighting, and appearance.

node_traces.evidence: The source shows a distinctive large light-blue mug to the left of the headphones. In the edited image, a light-blue mug-shaped remnant remains at the former left-side location, while a mug is visible to the right of the headphones. The right-side mug is white/gray rather than blue, and another small mug-like object appears left of the headphones, so the source mug's identity and completed relocation are not reliably established. However, the remnant together with changed/additional mugs is credible evidence of an attempted or incomplete move, which the criteria count as partial progress and therefore pass.
